title: OL08-03A Export Manifest Completeness Planner

permissions.reason: Closure export planning is part of destructive-lifecycle orchestration and remains under the existing Core SYSTEM-only organization delete authority; no organization-role permission is added.

items.action: plan and inspect the organization closure export completeness manifest

frontend.reason: OL08-03A exposes SYSTEM metadata endpoints only; no UI, download, route, menu, form, or customer handover flow is added.

ui_permissions.reason: No UI authorization surface is added.

notes: Bounded OL08-03A only. The durable plan is tied to one organization + closure execution + schema version and persists planning metadata, explicit included/excluded/deferred completeness classifications, organization-scoped record counts, record-ID-only fingerprints, and non-secret audit evidence. Reusable credential/secret tables are forbidden as count/fingerprint sources. No downloadable/persistent closure package, package retention, not_required success state, integrity_verified gate, customer-facing handover, credential revoke/purge, product-data/artifact deletion/anonymization, cleanup_complete/ready_for_tombstone state, backup policy, or Core tombstone is added. Failed read-only planning persists no false successful plan; retry is the same idempotent SYSTEM POST after the transient failure is resolved.
